## OSH Code 2020 — Transition Note

The Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 (Act 37 of 2020) consolidates the Mines Act 1952 in principle alongside twelve other central labour laws. **The accident-notice duty is retained under the consolidated regime.** The Code's commencement is state-by-state; across most states the relevant OSH Rules remain pending. Until your state notifies its OSH Rules and the consolidated filing channel is confirmed, file this notice under the legacy Mines Act / DGMS channel. Verify current commencement status for your state before any change in filing practice — this area is actively transitioning and should be re-confirmed within 90 days.
